Chapter I: The Awakening

Long ago, when the mists of Freynor still whispered secrets to the rivers, the first spellcrafters discovered the resonance of raw mana.

Chapter II: The Rules of Binding

1. Never invoke a flame spirit near dry parchment.
2. Keep your focus steady, lest the shadows take form.
3. Enjoy the journey.

Epilogue

May your ink never run dry and your pages never tear.
